recipe_steps.1: Rinse the lentils and place them in a saucepan with plenty of water.
recipe_steps.2: Bring to a boil and simmer for 12–15 minutes, until tender but not falling apart. Drain and set aside.
recipe_steps.3: Peel the onions and slice them thinly.
recipe_steps.4: Place the onions in a large flat plate, add the flour and 1 tsp salt, and toss well to coat.
recipe_steps.5: Heat the sunflower oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. / Test the oil with a small piece of onion; it should sizzle vigorously.
recipe_steps.6: Fry about ⅓ of the onions at a time for 5–7 minutes, stirring frequently, until golden brown and crisp.
recipe_steps.7: Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Sprinkle lightly with salt.
recipe_steps.9: Wipe out the saucepan, leaving a little oil behind.
recipe_steps.10: Add the cumin and coriander seeds and cook over medium heat for 1–2 minutes, stirring, until fragrant.
recipe_steps.11: Add the rice, olive oil, turmeric, allspice, cinnamon, sugar, ½ tsp salt, and a generous amount of black pepper.
recipe_steps.12: Stir well to coat the rice with the spices.
recipe_steps.13: Add the cooked lentils and 3½ dl water.
recipe_steps.14: Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer over very low heat for 15 minutes.
recipe_steps.15: Remove from the heat, lift the lid, place a clean kitchen towel over the pot, replace the lid, and let stand for 10 minutes.
recipe_steps.16: Gently fold half of the fried onions into the rice and lentils.
recipe_steps.17: Transfer to a serving dish and top with the remaining fried onions.
